description: An illustrator is setting up a new digital painting project with a standard layer structure. Create a new image in Krita with dimensions 1920x1080 pixels (File > New, set width to 1920 and height to 1080). Then create the following layer structure from bottom to top using the Layers panel: (1) 'Background' — the default bottom layer, rename it if needed, (2) 'Sketch' — a new paint layer for rough sketches, (3) 'Lineart' — a new paint layer for clean line work, (4) 'Color' — a new paint layer for base colors, (5) 'Shading' — a new paint layer for shadows and highlights. Save the file as /home/ga/Documents/exports/illustration_project.kra.
